title: GOAL: autonomy: automatic context handover, automatic merge to main with checks and rollback (human 2026-10-06)
spec: Human 2026-10-06: (1) 'for context management I want that part to be autonomous'; (2) 'merges dont really need my approval ... pipelines would be great with checks and a rollback option if something was bad but as long as we have that I dont need to manually approve'. Today planner-context --hook only prints 'write the checkpoint: uv run orchestrator handover ...' on every message once over [planner].handover_context_tokens, and every goal PR waits for the human to merge.
acceptance: handover runs without the Planner being asked
a green goal branch reaches main with a recorded rollback and no human step
